label: section
text: Human Subjects Training and Institutional Review Board (IRB) Approval

label: subsection
text: Training for the P.I. and Research Assistants

label: content
text: The P.I. has completed human subjects training. The research assistants will be required to complete human subjects training through the UCR Office of Research and Economic Development.

label: content
text: The longevity analysis will collect data on the length of time clusters have operated (including the length of time between first hires and closures for those that have disbanded). We will collect data from a minimum of 36 institutions, attempting to find dates of operation for all clusters authorized at those institutions.

label: content
text: The comparative analysis will collect data on performance and attitudes from cluster participants. The performance data will include publications, citations, research grants, patents, licenses, and start-ups founded by members of interdisciplinary cluster hires, as well as those of a matched sample of faculty hired through normal departmental mechanisms.

label: content
text: Data will be backed up on a weekly basis on a hard drive kept in a locked cabinet in the project office. The data will be preserved exclusively on the two project computers and the back-up hard drive.

label: content
text: Following the completion of the project, the data archive will be made available on the project website to researchers who are interested in pursuing questions related to cluster hiring.

label: content
text: The only individuals with access to the collected data will be the P.I. and research assistants.
